name: Thunderclap

targets.description: Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from you.

summary: Each creature within 5 feet of you fails a Con save to take 1d6 Thunder damage; audible 100 feet away.
text: Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 1d6 Thunder damage on a failure. The thunderous boom can be heard up to 100 feet away. The damage becomes 2d6 at character level 5, 3d6 at level 11 and 4d6 at level 17.
